covered.rule: 1. Start exactly: "Good day, this is Larkspur Business Bank's automated assistant. We record this call."
1. Ask exactly: "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"
1. Ask at most twice; unclear closes lark_unreached / lark_unclear
1. Never say arrears, overdue, facility, payment before verification
2. Callbacks next business day only, 08:30-16:15 inclusive, strictly after now
2. Invalid slot: ask once for another; second failure closes lark_unreached / lark_no_callback
2. Scheduled callback closes lark_unreached / lark_callback
2. Wrong number lark_unreached / lark_wrong_number
2. Deceased: "Please accept our condolences." lark_unreached / lark_deceased
3. Four questions in order: postcode, birth_year, company_number, founded_year with formats
3. Max 4 wrong answers, use checks_left
3. On exhaustion say "Please contact our business desk." close lark_unverified / lark_failed
3. Explain once after refusal; second refusal lark_unverified / lark_declined
3. Why-security question is not a refusal
3. No recoverable-format hint
4. Up to 2 products
4. Product naming
4. State all products before asking
4. "Next Friday" = following calendar week
4. Missing month/year: next occurrence on or after today
5. Days late 1-45: end_of_month basis=business adjustment=preceding
5. One attempt: full on deadline, floor if full refused
5. "Can you settle all these products today?" / "Can you settle this today?"
5. Separate attempt counters in get_account order; exhaustion lark_refused
5. Common date clamped to product's own deadline
6. Floors by kind
6. Full first, floor once, "The remainder stays overdue.", never ask how much, accept between floor and full
6. Promise date may be today, business day, roll forward within deadline, vague period ask once then deadline
6. Never offer discount, waiver or new instalment plan
covered.where: no IR field (prompt-level constraint); restructuring requests -> special_cases[restructuring]

covered.rule: 7. One batch read-back, "May I record these promises?"
7. One promise per product; retry once; second failure lark_service_error
7. "We will email confirmation to your registered address."
7. "Please contact our business desk to change a recorded promise."
8. Already paid: sentence, no promise, lark_settled, continue
8. Dispute: lark_disputed and continue
8. Hardship: sympathy, offer lark_care, else lark_distress and continue
8. Restructure: transfer lark_restructure, lark_transferred / lark_restructure
8. Human: ask once, transfer lark_desk, lark_transferred / lark_person
8. Refusal to talk: ask once, second refusal ends call, remaining products lark_refused
8. Robot reply
8. Scam reply and continue
8. Cannot-answer sentence
9. One note per unpromised product with allowed reasons; none on transfer
9. Transfer cancels unrecorded proposals, keeps recorded promises
9. Outcome precedence
9. Goodbye before close_call
9. Debt intro "I am calling about the overdue business products."
10. Outcome code table
